import { Router } from "express";
import { pool } from "../db.js";

const router = Router();

// Users

router.get("/users", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users");
    res.status(200).json(result.rows);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.get("/users/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const result = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(200).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.post("/users", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const allowed = ["username", "email", "password_hash", "role"];
    const cols = allowed.filter((c) => req.body[c] !== undefined);
    if (cols.length === 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Empty body" });
    }
    const values = cols.map((c) => req.body[c]);
    const params = cols.map((_, i) => "$" + (i + 1));
    const result = await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO users (" + cols.join(", ") + ") VALUES (" + params.join(", ") + ") RETURNING *",
      values
    );
    res.status(201).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.put("/users/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { username, email, password_hash, role } = req.body;
    const result = await pool.query(
      "UPDATE users SET username = $1, email = $2, password_hash = $3, role = $4 WHERE id = $5 RETURNING *",
      [username, email, password_hash, role, id]
    );
    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(200).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.delete("/users/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const result = await pool.query("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(204).send();
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });

});

router.post("/tags", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const allowed = ["name"];
    const cols = allowed.filter((c) => req.body[c] !== undefined);
    if (cols.length === 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Empty body" });
    }
    const values = cols.map((c) => req.body[c]);
    const params = cols.map((_, i) => "$" + (i + 1));
    const result = await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO tags (" + cols.join(", ") + ") VALUES (" + params.join(", ") + ") RETURNING *",

    );
    res.status(201).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.put("/tags/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { name } = req.body;
    const result = await pool.query(
      "UPDATE tags SET name = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *",
      [name, id]
    );
    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(200).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.delete("/tags/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;

      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(204).send();
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

// Post Tags

router.get("/posts/:postId/tags", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { postId } = req.params;
    const result = await pool.query(
      "SELECT * FROM tags WHERE id IN (SELECT tag_id FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = $1)",
      [postId]
    );
    res.status(200).json(result.rows);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.post("/posts/:postId/tags", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { postId, tagId } = req.body;
    const result = await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO post_tags (post_id, tag_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING *",
      [postId, tagId]
    );
    res.status(201).json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

router.delete("/posts/:postId/tags/:tagId", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { postId, tagId } = req.params;
    const result = await pool.query(
      "DELETE FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = $1 AND tag_id = $2",
      [postId, tagId]
    );
    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });
    }
    res.status(204).send();
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

export default router;
